text: {"lessons":["I have often sold winning positions, so I should avoid letting the satisfaction of locking in gains alone decide when to sell.","I have bought back into stocks at higher prices after selling them; I should consider the current outlook and my overall plan rather than react to regret or fear of missing out.","A small short-term account decline is not a reason to make impulsive trades; I should weigh each decision carefully, since losses feel especially painful to me."]}
